notes: Draft configuration: The supplied road-course configuration identifies Osier Way, the southern A421 roundabout return, the bypass to the Great Slade hook, Middle Slade and Top Angel. Council planning material independently identifies the Buckingham industrial estate, Top Angel and Osier Way road network. Exact current public OSM road nodes locate the connected route. The complete independently measured 1,694.2 m retains its 83.2 m difference from the supplied 1,611 m; historical road realignments and lane placement remain draft. The Lenborough Road alternative belongs to the separate Combo selection; estate parking aisles and dead-end access spurs are excluded. No coordinates are moved to the supplied layout image, length or timing data. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1694.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 47 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
